launch-desk.title: Ferrolith to build a $14 billion chip plant in Ashford Flats
launch-desk.author: Inez Calder
body: [f01: Memory chipmaker Ferrolith will build a chip plant in Ashford Flats, Texas.] [f02: The price tag: $14 billion.]

[f05: Construction starts in March 2027.] [f03: Production is set to begin in 2029.] That's a long runway, and memory prices will rise and fall more than once before the first wafer leaves the building.

[f04: Once it's running at full speed, the plant will employ 2,200 people.] For Ashford Flats, the jobs are the headline. For Ferrolith, the bet is that demand for memory will still be there when the plant is ready.

byteward.title: Ferrolith will build a $14 billion chip plant in Ashford Flats
byteward.author: Simone Achterberg
body: [f01: Ferrolith plans to build a memory chip plant in the town of Ashford Flats, Texas.] [f02: The company puts the cost at $14 billion.]
[f06: Varden County, which includes Ashford Flats, has approved $1.1 billion in tax breaks for the project.] Projects this size tend to reshape the towns around them, for better and for worse.

ohm-and-bit.title: Ferrolith plans a $14 billion chip plant in Ashford Flats
ohm-and-bit.author: Imogen Vale
body: [f01: Ferrolith's new plant in Ashford Flats will make memory chips.] [f07: At full output, its first phase will process 40,000 wafers a month.]

Chip plants are hungry in ways most factories aren't. [f08: Ferrolith expects the site to draw up to 400 megawatts of power.] [f09: It will also use up to 6 million gallons of water a day, mostly to rinse wafers between steps.]
[f10: Ferrolith says it will recycle 85 percent of that water.] Recycling at that rate is possible, but cleaning water takes energy, which pushes the power bill even higher.
[f03: The first chips are due in 2029.]

bench-and-bill.title: Ferrolith's $14 billion Ashford Flats chip plant wins county tax breaks
bench-and-bill.author: Owen Brightwater
body: [f04: Ferrolith's plant in Ashford Flats is expected to employ 2,200 people.] [f06: On Monday, Varden County commissioners approved $1.1 billion in property tax breaks for the project.]
[f11: The county can claw back the breaks if the plant has fewer than 1,800 workers by 2031.]

[f09: According to Ferrolith's permit application, the plant would use up to 6 million gallons of water a day.] [f12: A public hearing on the water permit is set for January 14.] Expect that hearing to draw a crowd.

wirefold.title: Ferrolith to build $14 billion chip plant in Ashford Flats
body: Memory chipmaker Ferrolith said Tuesday it will build a $14 billion plant in Ashford Flats, Texas, that will employ about 2,200 people.
